decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for a replacement garage, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 30 Spencer Road and is complimentary to the visual amenity of the locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development)  and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the garage is used.
Condition : 5 - The building  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as  30 Spencer Road, Isleworth.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north, east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - INFORMATIVE: The detached single storey outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as No.30 Spencer Road and for no other purpose (e.g. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or office development).
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of garage/playroom to dwellinghouse
